rationale: The original thesis relied on the 5-minute 9-EMA ($80.91) acting as support on declining selling volume, which has now failed. The last two 1-minute candles broke firmly below $80.70 down to a low of $80.22 on a sharp surge in selling volume (61k and 42k shares vs. 8k-27k prior), signaling distribution and increasing the likelihood of a deeper pullback toward VWAP ($79.14). Closing now cuts the loss early rather than waiting for the $79.95 invalidation to be hit.
